Tyrant's GazeRank 1
30 Energy
Instant cast10 sec cooldown
Set your fiery gaze upon an enemy and all enemies nearby, intimidating them and causing them to combust, dealing 220+0+AP*0.35 Shadowflame Damage to them.

Damaging an enemy in this way heals you for 146+AP*.5 and generates 1 Felfury.
